info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Channel Specific Advanced Voice Services Management-spec
info.description: The Channel-Specific Advanced Voice Services Management API facilitates the creation and management of tailored voice services for banking channels. This service allows organizations to set up advanced voice functionalities that enhance customer interactions and operational efficiency. Typical consumers include financial institutions looking to optimize their voice services based on specific channel needs. By using this API, developers can ensure that the voice services provided are aligned with both user requirements and business goals.

post.summary: Create a new advanced voice service configuration.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new configuration for advanced voice services in the specified channel. It supports various customization options to tailor the service based on user requirements.
